Quit LightCraft on the computer, then copy the whole library folder to the phone. Choose the folder containing catalog.snap, catalog.log and Originals. It must contain every original referenced in the catalog. The source is read-only and your current library is kept separately. Lightroom catalogs and custom color profiles are not supported by this transfer.

Choose a complete LightCraft library folder with catalog.snap, catalog.log and Originals. A Lightroom .lrcat or a backup with no originals cannot be opened here.
The catalog points outside its own Originals folder, or contains an unsafe or ambiguous reference. Collect all linked originals into one native LightCraft library before copying it here.
The catalog or its journal is damaged or inconsistent. On the computer, open it with LightCraft, save, quit and copy the whole folder again.
At least one original or referenced subfolder is absent. Transfer the entire library and its Originals tree. Nothing has been added to the current library.
An original differs from the size or content recorded in the catalog, or cannot be identified. Verify the exported originals before trying again.
This transfer exceeds the mobile limits: 4 GiB total, 512 MiB per original, 32 MiB for each catalog file, and at most 12,000 entries. Use a smaller self-contained project library.
This project uses a custom color profile. Transfer without that profile would change the rendering, so this version has refused it.
